div.head: Af 5.4
div.ab: Eac cyrican friþ: gif hwylc mon cirican gesece for þæra gylta hwylcum, þæra ðe ær geypped nære, ond hine ðær on Godes noman geondette, sy hit healf forgifen.
Eac cirican frið: gif hwelc mon cirican gesece for ðara gylta hwylcum, þara ðe ær geypped nære, ⁊ hine ðær on Godes naman geandette, sie hit healf forgifen.
Eac cyricean frið: gyf hwylc man cyricean geséce for ðara gylta hwylcum, þæra ðe ær geypped nǽre, ⁊ hine ðær on Godes naman geandette, sy hít healf forgyfen.
Item. Qui ad ecclesiam confugiet pro quacumque culpa, que nondum propalata sit, et eam in nomine Domini gratis confitebitur, dimidium forisfacti condonetur ei.
Eac cirican frið: gif hwelce mon cirican gesece for ðara gylta hwylcum, þara ðe ær geypped nære, ⁊ hine ðær on Godes naman geandette, sie hit healf forgifen.
Likewise church sanctuary: if some man seeks out the church for whatever offense that had not previously been discovered, and he there confesses himself in God’s name, let it be forgiven by half.

The privilege of sanctuary belonging to a church includes also the following: if anyone takes refuge in a church, because of any offence which up to that time had been kept secret, and there confess his sin in God's name, half the punishment shall be remitted him.
Further sanctuary of the church: if any man has recourse to the church on account of any crime which has not been discovered, and there confesses himself in God’s name, it is to be half remitted.
Ferner Kirchenprivileg: wenn jemand eine Kirche aufsucht, wegen einer jener Verschuldungen, die früher nicht offenbar war, und sie dort in Gottes Namen bekennt, sei es halb vergeben.
Further, a church privilege: if someone seeks a church on account of any of those offences which was not previously disclosed, and confesses it there in God’s name, let it be half forgiven.
